title: Fusion workflows and connector status
description: Explore Fusion workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Autodesk

Fusion

Autodesk Fusion connects product design, engineering and manufacturing preparation in one cloud-connected workspace.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Explore a product form

Begin with current feature dimensions, datums and design intent. In the intended Fusion preview, explore a product form; the visible result is the revised solid and its driving constraints. Review interfaces, retained references and manufacturable intent before accepting or exporting it.

Validate a mechanical fit

Use the selected part or assembly revision. In the intended Fusion preview, validate a mechanical fit; the visible result is an updated assembly state with affected relationships highlighted. Review fit, motion, access and clearance before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare a manufacturing setup

Start from the reviewed model and release properties. In the intended Fusion preview, prepare a manufacturing setup; the visible result is a drawing, bill of materials or model definition tied to that revision. Review dimensions, revision identity and downstream completeness before accepting or exporting it.
